ida.r: Heads-up - AtlasRetail POC: customer asks for IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM delta + groups, Okta group->RBAC mapping, per-tenant domain proofing across multiple brands, delegated tenant admins, EU-only residency, and a clear cert-rotation + assertion signing policy. They also want info on SCIM soft-delete behavior and delta replay window. Need a short presales runbook + ballpark pricing. who can pick this up?

 tom.h: I can draft the runbook. quick clarifying Qs: expected peak SCIM delta rate (ops/min)? and do they expect sequence tokens for incremental snapshots or just PATCHes? that affects retry/backoff guidance.

 nisha.p: Sales intel: ~11k users, 3.2k DAU. daily full at 01:00 UTC, deltas throughout the day with bursts during morning onboarding (~2k ops in 30m). They prefer delta-first (PATCH) and want the ability to replay deltas for 7 days. Also require assertion signing with RSA-SHA256 and a documented cert rotation process.

 tom.h: Good. Notes for runbook: we support multi-valued SAML attributes for groups/roles and custom claim names. We don't auto-expand nested groups server-side 1 recommend flattening at IdP or using a short preprocess sync. Assertion size caution for large group counts will be documented. SCIM supports PATCH/PUT; soft-deletes are tombstones for 30 days by default (can extend on Dedicated). Delta replay window: hosted default 7 days; Dedicated can extend.

 sec-bot: sec-bot: Security note: confirm TLS 1.2+ enforced, support for RSA-SHA256 assertions, and provide certificate rotation checklist for customers (metadata upload, test assertion, cutover window). Also flag EU KMS requirement for regional keys.

 tom.h: I'll include an example SCIM PATCH and a sample SAML metadata snippet in the runbook. Example SCIM PATCH for email update:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://eu.api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/7c4a" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails[primary eq true].value","value":"anna@atlas.brand"}]}'
```

 nisha.p: They also asked about rate limits: can we give a per-minute and a burst guidance?

 pricing-bot: pricing-bot: provisional ballparks (GBP): Hosted standard = ~A1,000/mo; Hosted + SCIM quota bump = ~A2,800/mo; Dedicated POC setup = ~A19k one-time; Dedicated reserved throughput = ~A6.5k/mo. EU regional premium may apply. Figures provisional pending PM/legal.

 tom.h: Runbook owner: me for infra snippets; Nisha for customer-facing notes/security Q answers; pricing-bot will attach draft quote. Plan: I'll upload runbook draft and paste link here, Nisha will schedule tech-call for Thu 10:00 CET including sec and ops.

 ida.r: Great 1 please call out cert rotation steps and a short rollback plan in the runbook. I'll update CRM and keep the prospect warm. :thumbsup:
